description: The relaxed check allows the larger tensor to satisfy the predicate even when the other tensor cannot cover the kernel's traversal.
trigger: Call the bound exl3_mgemm with otherwise suitable tensors, valid weight IDs and (input slots, output slots, index count) of (4,2,4) or (2,4,3), with positive launch width.
expected_behavior: Reject the incompatible capacity or ensure every active matrix has a readable input and writable output.
actual_behavior: Both cases used to fail the equality check. The first now visits output slots 2 and 3 beyond C; the second reads input slot 2 beyond A, since only an effective input size of one broadcasts. No inspected indexed Python caller constructs these particular shapes; the extension binding is the established reach.

verification.description: Modeled acceptance, clamping and input/output slot offsets for both cases.
verification.limits: Symbolic bounds, not observed device accesses.

introductions.rationale: This wrapper change admits unequal capacities that the earlier index-count equality check rejected.
